capabilities: Inspect flat PDF text AcroForm fields and create a derivative with actual values and generated appearances
Lossless optimization of supported PDF raw/Flate streams with exact decoded graph checks
Create an intentionally reconstructed public Word copy, removing exact explicit strings and source metadata
Read, extract and convert the supported genuine RAR4/RAR5 subset through existing archive routes
retained_findings: Modified custom PDF form appearances cannot be silently discarded; changed fields require a verified supported appearance
Word hidden text inherited from styles and revision cell markers require explicit handling before public reconstruction
RAR public schemas must disclose compressed RAR4 refusal; complete decoding and checksum evidence remain required
limits: Initial PDF form profile is printable ASCII text, Helvetica/Courier, flat single-line widgets; Unicode is separate future work
PDF optimization preserves supported decoded graph content; unsupported filters/predictors refuse; output may honestly be not smaller
Word public copy is a lossy main-body paragraph/plain-table reconstruction, not automatic PII detection or formatting preservation
Inherited hidden styles and unsupported fields/revisions refuse; exact deny strings are checked throughout the returned package
RAR4 stored and supported RAR5 compressed profiles are supported; compressed RAR4 remains unavailable
